high_level_description: This image captures a serene urban scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, as indicated by the soft, warm hues in the sky. The sky is a gradient of light blue to orange and yellow near the horizon, with scattered clouds adding texture to the scene. The setting is an elevated roadway or overpass, with a concrete barrier on the left side that has a decorative metal railing. The barrier is painted white with red stripes at regular intervals. On the right side of the image, there is a road with a bus and a motorcycle passing by.
